text: Follow one annual sprinkler inspection from the field to the customer.
Three visits today. Riverside Medical Center is first.
The technician starts with site details and last year’s results already in place.
Check the items and record current test readings.
Document the painted sprinkler head with a photo, then send for review.
The office receives a report draft from the same inspection record.
Review the report in the company’s own layout and logo.
Residual pressure is 12% below last year, past the 10% line where NFPA 25 asks you to find the cause.
Create a repair quote from the finding. Sample total: $285.
Approve the report. The open deficiency remains visible until addressed.
The reviewed report is ready for the customer’s building record.
Results, photo evidence, the NICET inspector’s signature and a copy for the AHJ.
The building owner approves the repair quote right from the report.
Open past reports and see which inspections are due next month.
